label: XOR space compaction
subgoals: Group the chain outputs into XOR trees
Compute each output as the parity of its group's bits
Confirm that a single error always flips its group's output

label: Aliasing
subgoals: Recognize that two errors in one group cancel
Sum g choose 2 over the groups for aliasing pairs
Connect chains to several outputs to separate their columns

label: Unknown values and masking
subgoals: Mark every group containing an X as unobservable for that cycle
Count the chains in the groups free of X
Gate the X chain to a constant with masking logic
